series.name: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - grid and AC monitoring faults
series.notes: Single-phase hybrid, FoxCloud/app-driven. Strings are named text exactly as printed on the LCD. Do NOT merge with foxess-t-series-grid 'Grid volt fault' (different spelling, different remedy) or with the R-series 4-digit numerics. Verified against the full H1 V1.6 table: this exact four-row grid block is byte-identical on H1 G2, KH/KA and H3 - the codes are shared but the SERIES are kept separate because other rows in the same tables differ.

meaning.en: The inverter has lost the utility reference and isolated itself from the grid. Usually the AC side has actually opened.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne grid reference kho diya aur khud ko grid se alag kar liya. Aam tor par AC side khul chuka hota hai.

causes.en: Main AC MCB or RCD has tripped on the inverter feed.
causes.ur: Inverter feed ka main AC MCB ya RCD trip ho chuka hai.

causes.en: Utility outage, or loose/burnt AC terminal at the inverter or consumer unit.
causes.ur: Utility outage, ya inverter ya consumer unit par AC terminal loose ya burnt hai.

causes.en: MCB rating too small for the inverter - trips under high charge/force-charge current.
causes.ur: MCB rating inverter ke liye choti hai - high charge ya force-charge current par trip karti hai.

solutions.en: Check the grid MCB and RCD on the PV/solar board; reset if tripped. FoxESS wants a bi-directional 100 mA RCD, not 30 mA.
solutions.ur: PV/solar board par grid MCB aur RCD check karein, trip ho to reset karein. FoxESS ko bi-directional 100 mA RCD chahiye, 30 mA nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm MCB size against inverter rating: 3.7 kW = 20 A, 5/6/7 kW = 32 A, 8-10 kW = 64 A.
solutions.ur: Inverter rating ke hisaab se MCB size confirm karein: 3.7 kW = 20 A, 5/6/7 kW = 32 A, 8-10 kW = 64 A.

solutions.en: Torque-check and heat-check every AC terminal at the inverter and meter box; retighten or replace the burnt one.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur meter box ke har AC terminal ko torque aur heat ke liye check karein; burnt terminal ko tighten ya replace karein.

notes.en: Field guidance: 1 + 26 + 27 almost always appear together, and a repeat trip within a day means a real fault, not a nuisance trip. Do not keep resetting - escalate.
notes.ur: Field guidance: 1 + 26 + 27 aam tor par saath aate hain, aur ek din mein dobara trip hona asal fault hai. Bar bar reset na karein - installer ko bulayein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is above or below the inverter's permitted window, so the inverter refuses to connect.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage inverter ki ijazat range se upar ya neeche hai, is liye inverter connect nahi ho raha.

causes.en: High export time grid voltage, typical of a long line or a substation transformer tap set too high.
causes.ur: Export ke waqt grid voltage high - lambi line ya substation transformer ka tap zyada par hona aam wajah hai.

causes.en: Severe grid dip from a large motor or generator starting on the same feeder.
causes.ur: Wahi feeder par kisi bade motor ya generator ke chalne se grid voltage gir gaya.

causes.en: Protection window set too narrow for a local grid that runs at the edge of tolerance.
causes.ur: Protection window aise grid ke liye chota set hai jo tolerance ke kinare par chalta hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to settle; the unit reconnects on its own once voltage is back in range.
solutions.ur: Grid settle hone dein; voltage range mein aate hi unit khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: Log into FoxCloud and read the live RVolt trend; if it sits near the upper limit, log the peak value.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein login karke live RVolt trend dekhein; agar upar ki limit ke qareeb hai to peak value note kar lein.

solutions.en: If voltage is genuinely high, have the utility (in Pakistan, the DISCO feeder office) check and correct transformer tapping before touching inverter settings.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage wakai high hai, to inverter setting chhune se pehle utility se (Pakistan mein DISCO feeder office) check karwa kar transformer tapping theek karwayein.

notes.en: Widely reported on H1 in markets with long rural feeders. Peak readings around 250-255 V AC on a 230 V nominal supply are typical.
notes.ur: Lambi rural feeder wale ilaqa mein H1 par ye bohat aam hai. 230 V nominal par 250-255 V AC tak ke peak readings aam hain.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the permitted band, so the inverter has disconnected from the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency ijazat range se bahar hai, is liye inverter ne grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Utility frequency excursion, common during feeder load shedding or generator handover.
causes.ur: Utility frequency excursion - feeder load shedding ya generator handover ke waqt aam hai.

causes.en: Inverter running in parallel with a generator that is governing frequency poorly.
causes.ur: Inverter aise generator ke saath parallel chal raha hai jo frequency theek se control nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to return to nominal; the unit will reconnect automatically.
solutions.ur: Grid nominal par aane ka intezar karein; unit khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: Read live frequency in FoxCloud and note whether excursions coincide with generator running hours.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein live frequency padhein aur note karein ke excursion generator chalne ke waqt hote hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: If a generator is involved, adjust its governor and set the inverter grid-tie limits per the generator's own voltage/frequency window.
solutions.ur: Agar generator involved hai to uska governor adjust karein aur inverter ke grid-tie limits generator ke voltage/frequency window ke mutabiq set karein.

notes.en: Pakistan nominal supply is 230 V / 50 Hz; a sustained 50 Hz +/- 0.5 Hz excursion will trip this.
notes.ur: Pakistan nominal supply 230 V / 50 Hz hai; 50 Hz +/- 0.5 Hz ka mustaqil excursion is code ko trigger karega.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

title.en: 10-minute average grid voltage out of range
title.ur: 10 minute ka average grid voltage range se bahar

meaning.en: The rolling 10-minute average of grid voltage has been out of range. This is a sustained-condition protection, not a spike detector.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage ka chalta hua 10 minute ka average range se bahar chala gaya hai. Yeh mustaqil-condition protection hai, spike detector nahi.

causes.en: Sustained grid over-voltage, often with high PV export into an already-high feeder.
causes.ur: Grid ka mustaqil over-voltage - aksar already high feeder mein zyada PV export ke saath.

causes.en: Substation transformer tap set high and left uncorrected.
causes.ur: Substation transformer ka tap high set hai aur theek nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: Protection limit set to the 253 V default while the local grid legitimately runs at 252-254 V.
causes.ur: Protection limit 253 V default par hai jabke local grid waqai 252-254 V par chalta hai.

solutions.en: Check the 10-minute average voltage in FoxCloud and record the peak before touching anything.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein 10 minute ka average voltage dekhein aur kuch bhi chhune se pehle peak note karein.

solutions.en: On H1, open Settings > On-Grid > Grid Para > 'Vac 10min Avg' (PIN 0-0-0-0) and raise the limit only after the utility has confirmed the voltage.
solutions.ur: H1 par Settings > On-Grid > Grid Para > 'Vac 10min Avg' kholein (PIN 0-0-0-0) aur limit sirf tab barhayen jab utility ne voltage confirm kar liya ho.

solutions.en: Ask the DISCO feeder office to log grid voltage and correct the substation transformer tap - the durable fix.
solutions.ur: DISCO feeder office se grid voltage log karwa kar substation transformer tap theek karwayein - yehi permanent hal hai.

notes.en: FoxESS’s own remedy is only "wait, the system will reconnect" - the manual gives no menu path for this limit. An earlier pass of this job cited a legacy numeric code 28 and a Settings > On-Grid > Grid Para > Vac 10min Avg path from a forum post; that source was NOT re-fetched here, so neither is asserted. Treat the parameter path as unverified until a FoxESS document confirms it.
notes.ur: FoxESS ka apna hal sirf "intezar karein, system khud reconnect ho jayega" hai - manual is limit ka koi menu path nahi deta. Is kaam ke pichle pass ne ek forum post se legacy numeric code 28 aur Settings > On-Grid > Grid Para > Vac 10min Avg ka path liya tha; wo source is dafaan dobara fetch nahi hua, is liye hum us par bharosa nahi karte. FoxESS ke kisi document ke confirm karne tak is parameter path ko unverified samjhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)
